page_title: The fastest way to take a customizable screenshot

summary.name: Lightshot
summary.one_liner: Lightshot is a free screenshot tool that captures a selected screen area and lets you edit it and share it via a short link.
use_cases: capture a selected area of the desktop
share a screenshot via a short link
find similar images found on screen
quick screen capture for bug reports or chats
summary.what_it_does: Lightshot lets you select any area of your desktop and take a screenshot with two button clicks. You can edit screenshots instantly when taking them or later using an online editor. Captured screenshots can be uploaded to a server to get a short link right away. It also includes a similar image search, where you select an image on screen and find similar images. The page describes a simple, intuitive user interface.
notable: Two-click capture of a selected screen area
Short shareable links for uploaded screenshots
Instant and online editing of screenshots
caveats: Uploading screenshots relies on storing them on the Lightshot server
Page does not state pricing details; listing marks it as Freeware
